## Summary
- 08/07: Ravens re-sign WR Zay Flowers to a 4-year, $140M extension, matching Justin Jefferson's $35M/year average. [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2085841403737784366)
- 08/08: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (2x Pro Bowl) considered day-to-day with a quad contusion after leaving practice; team not concerned long-term. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/zay-flowers-day-to-day-quad-contusion-training-camp-injury-2026)

- 08/08: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan plans to coach next week's preseason opener vs. the Titans as he recovers from his July 14 car crash (concussion, broken ribs). [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2086173560620335343)
- 08/08: Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil was evaluated for a shoulder/neck injury after getting hurt in 1-on-1s; beat reporter wouldn't be surprised if he misses time. [Garafolo](https://x.com/MikeGarafolo/status/2086132918435381611)
